WITH sku_commitment_totals AS ( SELECT model_id,sku_id,SUM(qty) qty FROM () c GROUP BY model_id,sku_id ), sku_capacity AS ( SELECT pv.sku_id,COUNT(*) qty FROM bike_vehicle v JOIN bike_production_vehicle pv ON pv.vehicle_id=v.id WHERE v.status=2 AND NOT GROUP BY pv.sku_id ), sku_model_status AS ( SELECT c.model_id,SUM(c.qty) sku_committed_qty,SUM(GREATEST(c.qty-COALESCE(p.qty,0),0)) sku_shortage_qty FROM sku_commitment_totals c LEFT JOIN sku_capacity p ON p.sku_id=c.sku_id GROUP BY c.model_id ), commitment_totals AS ( SELECT model_id,SUM(CASE WHEN kind='TEMPORARY' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) temporary_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN kind='ORDER' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) order_qty FROM () c GROUP BY model_id ), physical_rows AS ( SELECT v.model_id,w.id warehouse_id,w.warehouse_name,l.id location_id,l.location_name, COUNT(*) physical_qty,SUM() quarantined_qty, MIN(v.stock_in_time) stock_in_date FROM bike_vehicle v LEFT JOIN bike_warehouse w ON w.id=v.current_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN bike_warehouse_location l ON l.id=v.current_location_id WHERE v.status=2 GROUP BY v.model_id,w.id,w.warehouse_name,l.id,l.location_name ), all_rows AS ( SELECT * FROM physical_rows UNION ALL SELECT c.model_id,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,0,0,NULL FROM commitment_totals c WHERE c.temporary_qty+c.order_qty>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM physical_rows p WHERE p.model_id=c.model_id) ), ordered_rows AS ( SELECT p.*,COALESCE(m.model_name,'-') model_name,COALESCE(c.temporary_qty,0) model_temporary_qty, COALESCE(c.order_qty,0) model_order_qty, COALESCE(sms.sku_shortage_qty,0) sku_shortage_qty, COALESCE(c.temporary_qty,0)+COALESCE(c.order_qty,0)-COALESCE(sms.sku_committed_qty,0) legacy_model_committed_qty, GREATEST(0,SUM(p.physical_qty-p.quarantined_qty) OVER(PARTITION BY p.model_id)-COALESCE(c.temporary_qty,0)-COALESCE(c.order_qty,0)) model_new_commitment_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY p.model_id ORDER BY COALESCE(p.warehouse_id,0),COALESCE(p.location_id,0)) row_no, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY p.model_id) row_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.physical_qty-p.quarantined_qty) OVER(PARTITION BY p.model_id ORDER BY COALESCE(p.warehouse_id,0),COALESCE(p.location_id,0) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) prior_capacity FROM all_rows p LEFT JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=p.model_id LEFT JOIN commitment_totals c ON c.model_id=p.model_id LEFT JOIN sku_model_status sms ON sms.model_id=p.model_id ), commitment_rows AS ( SELECT o.*, GREATEST(0,LEAST(model_temporary_qty,CASE WHEN row_no=row_count THEN model_temporary_qty+model_order_qty ELSE prior_capacity+physical_qty-quarantined_qty END)-prior_capacity) temporary_locked_qty, GREATEST(0,LEAST(model_temporary_qty+model_order_qty,CASE WHEN row_no=row_count THEN model_temporary_qty+model_order_qty ELSE prior_capacity+physical_qty-quarantined_qty END)-GREATEST(prior_capacity,model_temporary_qty)) order_reserved_qty FROM ordered_rows o ), inventory_projection AS ( SELECT c.*,temporary_locked_qty+order_reserved_qty locked_qty, GREATEST(0,physical_qty-quarantined_qty-temporary_locked_qty-order_reserved_qty) available_qty, GREATEST(0,temporary_locked_qty+order_reserved_qty-physical_qty+quarantined_qty) shortage_qty, COALESCE(DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(),stock_in_date),0) age_days FROM commitment_rows c ), inventory_model_metrics AS ( SELECT model_id,MAX(sku_shortage_qty) sku_shortage_qty,MAX(legacy_model_committed_qty) legacy_model_committed_qty, MAX(model_new_commitment_qty) model_new_commitment_qty FROM inventory_projection GROUP BY model_id )

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(physical_qty),0) physicalQty,COALESCE(SUM(quarantined_qty),0) quarantinedQty, COALESCE(SUM(locked_qty),0) lockedQty,COALESCE(SUM(temporary_locked_qty),0) temporaryLockedQty, COALESCE(SUM(order_reserved_qty),0) orderReservedQty,COALESCE(SUM(available_qty),0) availableQty, COALESCE(SUM(shortage_qty),0) shortageQty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sku_shortage_qty),0) FROM inventory_model_metrics) skuShortageQty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(legacy_model_committed_qty),0) FROM inventory_model_metrics) legacyModelCommittedQty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(model_new_commitment_qty),0) FROM inventory_model_metrics) modelNewCommitmentQty FROM inventory_projection
